metaDescription: Kevin traces Peter Thiel's Lord of the Rings naming habit, from Palantir and Anduril to Narya Capital, and covers the GloriFi anti-woke bank.
summary: This video is about how many companies tied to Peter Thiel are named after Lord of the Rings references, and about GloriFi, a short-lived anti-woke bank Thiel backed. Kevin notes that Palantir comes from the seeing stones and Anduril from Aragorn's sword. He lists Mithril Capital, Valar Ventures, Rivendell One LLC, Lembas LLC and Arda Capital, and says Valar was funded by Jeffrey Epstein. He says J.D. Vance's Narya Capital was largely funded by Thiel's network, and mentions Palmer Luckey's Erebor. Kevin then describes GloriFi, whose investors he says included Thiel and Candace Owens, and notes he is not suggesting Owens is part of Thiel's circle.
